sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.

sources.title: Buy Microduck: Small robot. Super smart.
sources.snippet: Microduck Small robot. Super smart. The 10 inch bipedal AI robot that walked onto Jensen Huang's stage at NVIDIA GTC Berlin, and stole the show.

sources.title: MicroDuck Guides — Simulation, Policies & Training
sources.snippet: Run the official browser or daemon simulation, inspect and reset robot policies, prepare a CUDA training run, and diagnose common MicroDuck errors with source-linked guides.

sources.title: Train in Simulation, Deploy on a Real Robot: Microduck with Isaac Lab 3.0
sources.snippet: This tutorial walks you through training and evaluating Microduck with Isaac Lab and Newton, then exporting the policy for deployment. From there, you can share your model on the Hugging Face Hub, test its compatibility and compete in Microduck Arena, or put it to work on your own Microduck. Walking is the starting point—with linked examples to help you explore more of Isaac Lab 3.0.
